$description: ContentGrid (library wave 3, extend): the tokens of the masonry and justified-rows layouts. The grid's gaps are in components.tokens.json; the card width of each size is set on the grid by its size class.

content-grid-masonry-row-gap.$description: Masonry: the space under each item in its column (the same density-aware gap as between the columns).

content-grid-justified-last-row-grow.$description: Justified rows: how strongly the spacer after the last item takes the rest of the last row, so its items keep their own width instead of stretching.

content-grid-ratio-1-1.$description: Justified rows: the width of a 1:1 item, in row heights.

content-grid-ratio-4-3.$description: Justified rows: the width of a 4:3 item, in row heights (the default).

content-grid-ratio-3-2.$description: Justified rows: the width of a 3:2 item, in row heights.

content-grid-ratio-16-9.$description: Justified rows: the width of a 16:9 item, in row heights.

content-grid-ratio-21-9.$description: Justified rows: the width of a 21:9 item, in row heights.

content-grid-ratio-3-4.$description: Justified rows: the width of a 3:4 (portrait) item, in row heights.

content-grid-ratio-9-16.$description: Justified rows: the width of a 9:16 (tall portrait) item, in row heights.
